notes.title: THANKS FOR GAMESCOM
notes.notes:
Last week we had the opportunity to participate in Gamescom 2021 and also present Choppa: Rescue Rivals in Indie Arena Booth Online! Thank you all so much for your interest in our game! We're currently improving the game from all the valuable feedback you gave us and getting ready to show you the new and improved version at Steam Next fest in October.

Hope to see you again at Steam NEXT Fest!

notes.title: Beta Week Extended!
notes.notes:
Great news! 🚁 

We're extending the Beta Test period so you'll have more time to play with your friends and family over the weekend!

Have a great Easter everyone!

notes.title: Beta Test Week #1
notes.notes:
Hello aeronauts!

We're having our first closed Beta Test Week this week & we are truly humbled by the amount of attention our beta week has received. Thank you, everyone!

This Beta Week will not be the last, so if you'd like to try the game stay tuned for more updates and announcements! 


[b]If you encounter any bugs or are having any trouble with the game, please contact us through [url=https://discord.gg/XKYx76f]Discord[/url] or the in-game Beta Feedback form[/b]
